_meta.comment: Maps page slug → corpus categories (in tmp/scam_research/corpus.json) + display fields. Add new slugs here when adding new general-scam pages.

display.name: Pig-Butchering Scams
display.subtitle: Romance + Crypto · 7 variants
display.headline_stat: $5.8B stolen from Americans in 2024
display.tagline: Hinge → WhatsApp → 'uncle's signals' → fake exchange. Plus the 'wrong number' SMS variant, LinkedIn mentor pivot, withdrawal-tax trap, and the recovery-scam follow-on that targets victims twice.

display.name: AI Voice-Clone Scams
display.subtitle: Family Emergency + Workplace BEC · 5 variants (estimated)
display.headline_stat: Cloning a voice now requires only 3 seconds of audio
display.tagline: AI-cloned bail calls, CFO impersonation for MFA reset, AARP's #1 emerging fraud category. Targets parents, grandparents, and IT support desks.

display.name: Bank Impersonation & Zelle Scams
display.subtitle: Phone + App · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: $870M lost on Zelle since 2017 across 3 banks (CFPB Dec 2024)
display.tagline: Fake fraud-department calls, 'transfer to a safe account' scripts, reverse-payment Zelle traps. The highest-volume scam category in r/personalfinance.

display.name: Tech-Support Scams
display.subtitle: Pop-up + Phone · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: $1.46B lost to tech-support scams in 2024 (FBI IC3)
display.tagline: Microsoft / Apple / Geek Squad pop-up traps that talk victims into installing ConnectWise or AnyDesk for full remote access. Bank drain follows.

display.name: USPS / Package Text Scams
display.subtitle: SMS · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Universal: every U.S. phone gets these multiple times per month
display.tagline: 'Your USPS package can't be delivered' phishing, fake redelivery fees, FedEx + Amazon variants. Sender almost always +63 (Philippines).

display.name: Real-Estate Wire Fraud (BEC)
display.subtitle: Email · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: $2.95B BEC losses in 2024, 25% YoY growth (FBI IC3)
display.tagline: Closing-attorney email compromise, last-minute wire-instruction swap, vendor invoice fraud. Six-figure individual losses common.

display.name: Fake Job Offers & Recruiter Scams
display.subtitle: LinkedIn + Email · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Targets recently laid-off tech workers; 'Kindly' is the canonical tell
display.tagline: Equipment-deposit fraud, fake interview phishing, salary-advance check scams. r/recruitinghell archives the canonical examples.

display.name: Marketplace Scams (FB / Craigslist)
display.subtitle: Web + App · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: ~25% of FB Marketplace listings are scams in some categories
display.tagline: Buyer-side too-good-to-be-true Zelle deposits, seller-side 6-digit-code 2FA bypass, 'send my nephew to pick up' setups. Cash + in-person solves 99%.

display.name: Medicare & Elder-Targeted Scams
display.subtitle: Phone + Mail · 6 variants
display.headline_stat: Adults 60+ lost $3.4B to fraud in 2024 (FBI IC3)
display.tagline: 'New plastic Medicare card' calls, DME (catheter) billing fraud, fake jury-duty warrant calls, utility shutoff scares. Adult Protective Services is the intervention path.

display.name: Recovery Scams (Meta-Scam)
display.subtitle: DM + Telegram · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Within hours of any public victim post: 5–50 recovery-scam DMs
display.tagline: The parasite scam targeting victims of every other scam. Fake 'fund recovery specialists,' 'blockchain forensic experts,' upfront 'investigation fees.' Block all DMs without exception.

display.name: Gift-Card Scams
display.subtitle: Phone + Retail · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: $217M lost to gift-card scams in 2024 (FTC)
display.tagline: Boss-impersonation 'urgent gift' scripts, retail-cashier card-swap, sticker-overlay redemption fraud. Universal advice: gift cards are never used for legitimate payments.

display.name: Concert & Event Ticket Scams
display.subtitle: Web + Reddit · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: $20K+ losses documented in escalating-fee schemes
display.tagline: Fake screenshot proof, transfer scams, 'I have extras' Reddit DMs. Verified resale (Ticketmaster Verified Resale, AXS Marketplace) is the only safe path.

display.name: Sextortion
display.subtitle: DM + Email · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FBI 2025: 75K+ reports · NCMEC: 36+ teen-boy suicides since 2021
display.tagline: If it's happening right now: do not pay, stop replying, save the messages, report to NCMEC (under 18) or FBI IC3 (adults). FBI + NCMEC + DOJ verified.

display.name: Door-to-Door Contractor Scams
display.subtitle: Doorstep + Post-storm · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FBI: $1B+/yr fraudulent roof claims · BBB driveway losses up to $9,200
display.tagline: Storm-chaser roofing, asphalt 'leftover materials', post-storm tree work, fake-inspection HVAC, door-to-door solar. The single rule: never sign or pay on the day a stranger knocks. FTC Cooling-Off Rule + state-AG verified.

display.name: Phone-Impersonation Government Scams
display.subtitle: Phone · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FTC 2025: 330K+ govt-imp complaints (+25%) · Older-adult $100K+ losses: $445M (+8x since 2020)
display.tagline: SSA 'number suspended', IRS tax-debt arrest threat, sheriff jury-duty bond, ICE / CBP deportation, spoofed local-PD. One sentence defeats them all: real agencies never call to demand payment. FTC + SSA OIG + FBI verified.

display.name: Advance-Fee Loan & Debt-Relief Scams
display.subtitle: Loan + Debt-Relief · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FTC 2025: $7.3M + $16.7M permanent bans · 4 federal rules ban upfront fees
display.tagline: Bad-credit personal loan, student-loan forgiveness, credit-repair, mortgage modification, fake government grant. The single rule: federal law bans upfront fees for all of these. CROA + TSR + MARS + FTC verified.

display.name: Subscription-Trap & Free-Trial Scams
display.subtitle: Web + Mobile · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FTC 2025: Amazon $2.5B + Instacart $60M + Chegg $7.5M settlements
display.tagline: Free-trial auto-enrollment, hidden-subscription apps, pre-checked checkout boxes, cancellation labyrinths, weekly-billing AI/wellness apps. Two-rule defense: virtual card number + calendar reminder. ROSCA + FTC verified.

display.name: Rental Scams
display.subtitle: Facebook + Craigslist + Airbnb · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FTC: 65,000 rental scams since 2020 · 18-29yos 3x more likely to lose money
display.tagline: Fake apartment listing, hijacked Zillow listing, vacation-rental fake, Section 8 voucher scam, AI-deepfake listing. The single rule: never pay for a property you haven't seen in person. FBI + FTC + BBB + HUD verified.

display.name: QR Code Scams
display.subtitle: Sticker + Text + Email · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: Avg loss $1,225/victim 2025 · FBI 2025 alert on unsolicited-package QR
display.tagline: Parking-meter sticker overlay, restaurant-menu QR, unsolicited-package QR, toll-text QR, corporate quishing email. The single rule: type the URL yourself rather than scanning. FBI + FTC + NYC DOT verified.

display.name: Social Media Account Takeover
display.subtitle: Facebook + Instagram + WhatsApp · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FTC 2025: $2.1B social-media scam losses (+8x since 2020) · Facebook $794M
display.tagline: Phishing-link login, friend-recovery-code hijack, blue-check verification phishing, hijacked-friend crypto posts, recovery-scam follow-on. Single rule: authenticator-app 2FA + never share codes. FTC + Meta verified.

display.name: Amazon & Refund Scams
display.subtitle: Text + Email + Phone · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FBI 2025: $262M Amazon-scam losses · 80% of all brand-impersonation phishing
display.tagline: Fake refund text, Prime auto-renewal phishing, account-takeover phone call, product-recall scam, refund-overpayment remote-access. Single rule: log into amazon.com directly. FBI + FTC + Amazon verified.

display.name: Check Fraud & Overpayment Scams
display.subtitle: Mail + Marketplace + Job offer · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: FinCEN: 682K check-fraud SARs in 2024 (+95% since 2020) · USPS intercepts $1B+/yr
display.tagline: Mail-theft check washing, marketplace overpayment, secret-shopper fake check, job-offer first-paycheck, lottery advance-fee. Single rule: wait for funds to fully clear. FinCEN + USPIS + FTC verified.

display.name: Car-Buying Scams
display.subtitle: Craigslist + FB Marketplace + AutoTrader · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: Fake escrow, VIN cloning, curbstoning, history-report harvest, overseas wire fraud
display.tagline: Fake escrow, VIN cloning, curbstoning, fake history-report sites, overseas-buyer wire fraud. Single rule: in-person inspection + bank-mediated payment. FTC + AARP + state DMV verified.

display.name: Charity & Disaster Scams
display.subtitle: GoFundMe + Email + Door-to-door · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: $34M stolen across 2025 hurricanes Helene + Milton + CA wildfires
display.tagline: Fake GoFundMe, sound-alike charities, FEMA impersonation, post-disaster contractor scams, donation-phishing email. Single rule: verify via Charity Navigator + Candid; FEMA never charges. FBI + FTC + FEMA + IRS verified.

display.name: Telegram Crypto Pump & Wallet-Drainer Scams
display.subtitle: Telegram + Discord + X · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: Wallet drainers stole $500M in 2024 · Inferno: $80M+ from 134K victims
display.tagline: Telegram pump-and-dump, wallet drainer (Inferno), fake support channels, fake airdrop, fake trading-bot subscription. Single rule: never connect wallet at unsolicited request. SEC + Group-IB + Scam Sniffer verified.

display.name: Celebrity-Impersonation Crypto Scams
display.subtitle: YouTube + TikTok + X · 5 variants
display.headline_stat: Deepfake fraud H1 2025: $410M · Celebrity-imp investment scams: $401M total
display.tagline: Musk deepfake YouTube livestream, hijacked channel + executive deepfake, TikTok / FB giveaway, fake celebrity email pitch, X verified-account hijack. Single rule: no celebrity giveaway is real. SEC + FBI + Chainabuse verified.

display.name: Door-to-Door Contractor Scams
display.subtitle: In-person + Phone · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Driving Florida insurance crisis; statewide rate increases
display.tagline: Storm-chaser roofers finding hail damage you don't have, 'assignment of benefits' insurance fraud, solar door-to-door pressure sales. Real adjusters work for your insurance, not strangers.

display.name: Government Phone Impersonation Scams
display.subtitle: Phone + Mail · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Highest call-volume scam category in the U.S.
display.tagline: 'SSN suspended' robocalls, fake IRS tax-debt threats, fake CPA refund-hijack schemes. Real SSA + IRS contact starts with mail, never phone.

display.name: Charity & Disaster-Donation Scams
display.subtitle: Web + In-person · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Surges 200-500% within 48h of any major disaster
display.tagline: Fake veteran charities, GoFundMe disaster scams, street Venmo solicitations, fake-charity credit-card test fraud against legitimate nonprofits. Verify via CharityNavigator before giving.

display.name: Apartment Rental Scams
display.subtitle: Zillow + Craigslist + FB · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: App-fee identity-theft variant opens credit cards in your name
display.tagline: Too-good-to-be-true Zillow/Craigslist listings, 'landlord traveling' Zelle deposits, fake application sites that harvest SSN + credit. Never wire before in-person tour.

display.name: Used-Car Private-Sale Scams
display.subtitle: FB Marketplace + Craigslist · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Title-washing + odometer rollback are top losses
display.tagline: Stolen-title pivots, fake-Carfax-on-phone, distract-while-tampering during test drives, Spanish-translator buyer scripts. Always run independent VIN check.

display.name: Amazon & Refund Scams
display.subtitle: App + Phone + Mail · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Brushing scam = your data is in a leak; you are not the target
display.tagline: Refund-promise-not-paid by Amazon support, fake Chinese drop-shippers, phishing 'Amazon refund notification' texts, brushing-scam mystery packages. Mostly recoverable through Amazon.

display.name: Puppy & Pet-Sale Scams
display.subtitle: Web + FB · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Walmart Pay deposit + no AKC info = guaranteed scam
display.tagline: Fake breeder websites, Walmart Pay deposit demands, no AKC verification, no in-person visit. AKC parent-club breeder lists are the only safe path.

display.name: Fake Check & Overpayment Scams
display.subtitle: Mail + Email · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Bank closes your account when the check bounces
display.tagline: 'Mystery shopper' jobs, 'remote PA' overpayment, FB Marketplace overpayment, fake company refund checks. ChexSystems blackballs you when the check bounces 5 days later.

display.name: Loan & Debt-Relief Scams
display.subtitle: Phone + Mail · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: studentaid.gov is free; any third-party fee is a scam
display.tagline: 'Pre-approved $50K loan' robocalls, fake 'National Student Loan Forgiveness Center' calls, PSLF impersonators, advance-fee personal-loan traps. Real loans never require upfront fees.

display.name: QR Code ("Quishing") Scams
display.subtitle: In-person + Email · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: 73% of Americans scan QR codes without checking source
display.tagline: Sticker overlays on restaurant tables, fake parking-meter QRs, phishing email QRs, mystery-package QR traps. Always preview the URL before tapping.

display.name: Social Media Account Takeover & Impersonation
display.subtitle: FB + IG + X · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: FB recovery is essentially nonexistent — prevent, don't repair
display.tagline: 6-digit 2FA-code harvest via 'verify your listing,' compromised-friend-DMs-money scripts, X blue-check impersonation. Multi-factor auth via authenticator app (not SMS) is the floor.

display.name: Subscription-Trap & Free-Trial Card Scams
display.subtitle: Web + App · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: privacy.com virtual cards solve 100% of this category
display.tagline: 'Free trial' that requires credit card → impossible to cancel auto-renew, fake ChatGPT subscription sites, gym-membership trap variants. Use privacy.com burner cards with $1 limit.

display.name: Lottery & Sweepstakes Scams
display.subtitle: Phone + Mail + DM · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Real lottery winners never pay fees up front
display.tagline: 'You won the Powerball' fee-extraction calls, Publishers Clearing House impersonation, Twitter 'lottery winner giving away money' bait-and-switch. Real prizes never require upfront tax.

display.name: Timeshare Exit-Company Scams (Meta-Scam)
display.subtitle: Phone + Seminar · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Exit industry preys on victims of the timeshare industry
display.tagline: $5K-$10K upfront 'attorney' fees that do nothing you can't do free at Tug2.net. Often pretend to be law firms; use real federal anti-fraud language to feign authority.

display.name: Celebrity Crypto-Giveaway Impersonation
display.subtitle: X + IG + Discord DM · 3 variants
display.headline_stat: Domains rotate weekly; same script under every celebrity name
display.tagline: Fake 'Elon Musk crypto casino' giveaways, hacked friend's IG sending you the link, Mr. Beast / Paul brothers / Trump-themed variants. Billionaires don't give money to strangers.

display.name: Telegram Pump-and-Dump & Wallet-Drainer Scams
display.subtitle: Telegram + Discord · 4 variants
display.headline_stat: Every investment group on a chat app is a scam, no exceptions
display.tagline: Pump-and-dump groups (founders pre-buy then signal), 'investment session' fee escalation, MetaMask drainer dApps, fake Reddit Web3 dev recruit scams. Never sign unlimited token approval.
